annotations.title: Read a brand from a codebase

description: Send a project's style files (Tailwind config, CSS variables, theme files, package.json, the root layout), at most 55,000 characters, and get back its colors for light and dark, its fonts, its corner radius and which of the logo paths you listed is the brand's. `ideare init` sends these when you are signed in. Free, within the daily import allowance.
name: read_repo
title: Read a brand from a codebase
